intro: Each Cosmic Age moves through four seasons in order. Return here during play for a quick reference.

seasons.title: Spring
seasons.subtitle: Set the Age, Deal the Cards & Build Your Tableau
seasons.summary: Set the Cosmic Age, take the Gift of the Age, roll your Sign, receive 3 Kismeta cards, build your Tableau, and lock cards until Winter.

seasons.title: Summer
seasons.subtitle: Craft, Distill, Trade & Contest
seasons.summary: Craft Houses and Mansions, Distill Reagents, trade with rivals, Duel for cards, Extinguish Coal, and Siege exposed Stones.

seasons.title: Autumn
seasons.subtitle: Harvest, Fuel & Conduct the Great Work
seasons.summary: Harvest Essence by Alignment, fuel Furnaces with Coal, then Fire, Temper, or Rekindle your Stone as the Great Work demands.

seasons.title: Winter
seasons.subtitle: Final Actions & Reset
seasons.summary: Unlock cards, optionally wager on the next Age, enforce limits, then Transit: shuffle the discard pile and pass the Key.
